description: This file defines the class WeightPackageSession, which manages shipment packaging details including package creation, item packing, cost estimation, and integration with shipping services like UPS within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WeightPackageSession
classes.description: Main class handling shipment packaging, cost calculations, and integration with shipping services such as UPS.

methods.name: createWeightPackageLine
methods.description: Creates a new package line with specified dimensions and shipment box type, adding it to the session lines.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment packaging process, including package creation, shipping cost calculation, and order status updates.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Calls UPS service to confirm shipment and retrieve actual shipping cost.

methods.name: diffInShipCost
methods.description: Checks if the difference between estimated and actual shipping costs exceeds allowed threshold.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages based on packed lines.

methods.name: changeOrderItemStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of order items to indicate completion.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates packaged lines with shipment items.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates total shipment weight in route segments.
